theme.grayAuto: mauve/slate/sage/olive/sand/gray via fixed Radix helper mapping
theme.colorData: @radix-ui/colors@3.0.0, 12 opaque + 12 alpha steps in both appearances; sRGB baseline
theme.mapping: Radix design data → accent-1..12 / gray-1..12 / material/size/motion tokens → shadcn semantic tokens and local slot styles. shadcn --accent remains a subtle interaction surface.

limitations: Visual comparison uses one pinned local Chromium on Linux and sRGB; system font stack resolves on that machine. It is not a cross-OS/browser certification.

100 gallery pairs cover all 45 sections in light/dark plus 10 open states (including a submenu and the alternate popper Select). The 12-combination multi-component matrix is representative, not every Cartesian permutation.
Pixel difference values are diagnostics, not a claimed fidelity percentage. Open overlay placement/scrolling follows Base UI; see per-row notes and screenshots.
Application examples are intentionally local demonstrations; no backend/account/payment/generator service is provided.
